    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ConsoleUI
    Interactive command-line interface controlling user inputs, navigation menus, and execution flows.
    CsvPersistenceService
    File-based CSV implementation of PersistenceService providing human-readable, zero-dependency storage for trading accounts, holdings, and transaction ledgers.
    GuiTheme
    Design system tokens, color palettes, typography, and styling utilities for the Swing trading GUI.
    Holding
    Represents an open position in an individual equity instrument within an investment portfolio.
    HoldingsTablePanel
    Portfolio positions table panel tracking owned equity lots, cost bases, and live unrealized returns.
    InsufficientFundsException
    Exception thrown when an account lacks sufficient liquid cash to execute an acquisition order.
    InsufficientSharesException
    Exception thrown when a user attempts to sell more shares than their active portfolio holds.
    InvalidStockSymbolException
    Exception thrown when an operation specifies an unrecognized or unlisted stock symbol.
    Main
    Main application driver providing dual-mode launching: modern Swing GUI desktop workstation by default, or interactive terminal console in headless and command-line environments.
    Market
    Exchange market engine that hosts traded equities, runs price updates, and broadcasts ticks.
    MarketObserver
    Observer listener interface for components subscribing to real-time equity price ticks.
    MarketWatchPanel
    Interactive equity quote directory table presenting live market spot prices, sectors, beta sensitivities, and trading volumes.
    MetricsHeaderPanel
    Top dashboard panel displaying high-level portfolio KPI cards and simulation controls.
    OrderTicketPanel
    Interactive order execution ticket enabling immediate market buy and sell orders with live capacity checks, quick-lot controls, and validation feedback.
    PersistenceException
    Exception thrown when reading from or writing to persistent storage fails.
    PersistenceService
    Service contract for persistent storage and retrieval of trading accounts and ledgers.
    Portfolio
    Manages an investor's active equity holdings, transaction audit history, and financial metrics.
    PriceUpdateStrategy
    Strategy interface defining mathematical price simulation algorithms for traded equities.
    RealWorldPriceStrategy
    Advanced quantitative price alteration strategy modeling multi-factor equities movements using Geometric Brownian Motion (GBM), Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) beta sensitivity, sector covariance, and Merton Jump-Diffusion unexpected news shocks.
    Sector
    Enumeration of key industry sectors traded on the global equities exchange.
    Stock
    Represents an equity instrument traded on the exchange with live pricing metrics, sector categorization, beta coefficient, and volatility parameters.
    TextTableFormatter
    Utility class providing professional ASCII tabular presentation, alignment, and formatting for financial data across console displays.
    TradingDashboardFrame
    Main application desktop window providing a financial trading workstation dashboard.
    TradingEngine
    Core transactional trading engine handling order matching, balance debits/credits, portfolio mutation, and execution reporting with strong validation guarantees.
    TradingException
    Base checked exception representing business logic errors within the trading exchange platform.
    TradingService
    Service contract defining core equity trading execution and exchange market operations.
    Transaction
    Immutable ledger record representing an executed trade (buy or sell) on the exchange.
    TransactionLedgerPanel
    Audit ledger table panel displaying chronological completed trade receipts and realized returns.
    TransactionType
    Enumeration representing the direction of a financial transaction.
    User
    Represents an individual trading account holder with liquid capital and an equity portfolio.
    VolatilityPriceStrategy
    Stochastic price movement strategy modeling equity volatility with bounded random walks and slight mean-reverting tendencies.
